title: Outbound
for: outbound sequencing and sales engagement: loading approved sequences, reading reply and meeting outcomes

manual.export: the sequence stays in content/ as text; a person loads it into the tool by hand
manual.drop: content/<piece>/ (the sequence steps as Markdown, one heading per step)

vendors.name: Outreach
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__outreach`) until checked
requires the Amplify add-on and an Outreach admin to enable the server
read, create and delete, no update by design; the admin toggles create (on by default) and delete (off by default), so there is no read-only endpoint, only the admin toggles
in the Claude connectors directory

auth.where: browser grant on first use (OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration)

vendors.name: Salesloft
caveats: an official server exists and is in the Claude connectors directory (OAuth, requires the Salesloft Agentic add-on); the endpoint is not published on the newsroom page, so add it from the directory or after a person reads the Salesloft help article
write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__salesloft`) until checked
third-party servers (CData read-only, StackOne, Gumloop) are generic connectors or community code, not the vendor server

vendors.name: lemlist
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__lemlist`) until checked (40+ actions)
an API-key mode also exists; the header format is not in the survey, so only the OAuth entry is listed
endpoint seen in a secondary listing; confirm on the help page before wiring

vendors.name: Instantly
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__instantly`) until checked (the help page names create and manage campaigns, add leads; destructive actions are marked)

the API key goes in the Authorization header; the help page does not print the scheme, a bearer token is assumed, confirm before wiring (the key may also go in the URL path, which this catalog does not use)
community `bcharleson/instantly-mcp` exists; judge as a script, not a vendor tool
endpoint read on the vendor help page today; the survey marks it as a secondary listing

vendors.name: Smartlead
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__smartlead`) until checked (the help page documents `get_campaign_status`, `fetch_lead_data`, `check_deliverability` and says campaigns can be managed)
SSE only, no streamable HTTP, and the API key travels as a URL query parameter; the vendor's own setup bridges it with `mcp-remote` over stdio, which is what is listed here
the key in a URL shows up in process lists and logs on the machine; rotate it if the machine is shared
the community `LeadMagic/smartlead-mcp-server` is archived; do not wire it

vendors.name: Apollo.io sequences
caveats: the same `apollo` server as enrichment.json; sequence tools were not verified in the survey, and if the tool list shows any add-to-sequence or send tool, deny the whole server (`mcp__apollo`) until reviewed
in the Claude connectors directory for Claude, not for Claude Code
endpoint from a secondary listing; confirm before wiring
